newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian DM bond issue delayed one week.
newsitem.headline: Colombian DM bond issue delayed one week.

text.p: Colombia will delay its 300 million mark Eurobond issue, originally scheduled for next week, for at least another week, a Finance Ministry spokesman said.
"For reasons of time and authorization we have had to delay the launch of the bonds for a week," Clemente del Valle, the Finance Ministry's chief of public credit said.

"The issue will take place, but not next week as planned because that would also clash with the meetings of the annual joint assembly of the International Monetary Fund and the World Bank next Friday."

Del Valle was unable to give an exact date for the bond launch. It was scheduled to take place soon after a three-day roadshow through Britain, Germany and Switzerland from September 23 to September 26. The Deutsche Bank, Morgan Grenfell and Merrill Lynch, which are co-lead managing the issue, said it would be 300 million marks of five-year floating rate bonds.
"The initial conditions have not been changed and remain the same. The only thing that has chnaged is the scheduled launch date," Del Valle said.
